Upgrade DV: DV17

Total Material Cost: Cost of most expensive component drug + 100eb

Two in one gets the job finished twice as fast when you’re in a rush. Just make sure to have some detox meds around for afterwards.

Invented Tech Upgrade. Spiked combines a single dose of two different Streetdrugs into a single Streetdrug. The DV to resist the Secondary Effect of both component drugs is increased by 2. The combined drugs’ effects and duration function independently of one another.

Cost: Invented Tech Upgrade (Upgrade DV17; material cost: the most expensive component drug + 100eb)
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • In Foundry, dose both component drugs.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).
